revision_note: Calibration-study revision. Categories and IDs are preserved; every criterion is expanded to a dual-check (static analysis AND runtime behaviour) and soft qualifiers are converted to hard determinants. This revision deliberately narrows the pass band to model a higher-stakes evaluation environment.

conditional_penalty.rule: If two consecutive sub-criteria fail within a single function block, an automatic -0.15 deduction is applied per occurrence.

criteria.statement: The package manifest shall strictly adhere to the checklist obligation set: the client framework, the API framework, the database driver and the mail client must be the entire dependency tree. A static manifest walk AND a runtime import-graph traverse must both resolve clean before a PASS is recorded.

The schema must enumerate exactly the entities the data model enumerates and nothing more. A static schema diff AND a runtime information_schema count must both prove zero tables, columns or seeded rows beyond the enumerated set.

No scheduler, message queue, cache or background worker shall exist for work the obligations did not ask for. A static process and timer scan AND a runtime handle audit must both show nothing for the criterion to pass.

The source must contain no outbound client for the weighbridge, the control system, the laboratory or the customer reporting system. A static import scan AND a runtime outbound-connection observation must both witness no client targeting any of the four.

No in-memory substitute for a table, no fixture file standing in for a seeded row and no log sink standing in for the mail service may survive anywhere in the tree. A static type map AND a runtime row-provenance check must both confirm that every entity is read from the declared store.

The ledger invariant must be expressed exactly once and every write path must reach that single assertion rather than restating the check. A static single-definition audit AND a runtime fault-injection pass over every write route must both record the refusal coming from the one shared code path.

Every derived integer shall strictly floor through the one shared helper; no module may round a figure another module floors and no call site may bypass the helper. A static call-graph walk AND runtime arithmetic spot-checks must both flag any bypass.

One idea must carry one identifier across the whole source; a consumption must never be a consumption in one module and a usage in another. A static symbol-pair scan AND a runtime declaration-versus-use trace must both find no drift.

Unit suffixes must be carried consistently in identifiers in every layer, not the API surface alone: a mass must end in _g, a proportion in _bp and a carbon figure in _mg_per_kg. An identifier audit AND a runtime payload scan must both satisfy the rule.

The arithmetic that derives every claim must live in its own module and the operational-record layer must never import it. The import graph AND a runtime module-load trace must both confirm the one-way dependency direction the brief states.

The pinned seed values must be read from one seed definition wherever they are needed and must never be duplicated as literals, including threshold constants, across modules. A literal-duplication scan must show zero restatements before a PASS is recorded.

A rule or literal set that governs more than one route must be defined once and referenced by every site, never restated. A static symbol lookup AND a runtime reference count must both resolve to exactly one defining site.

No exported symbol may be unreferenced, and no symbol may be exported solely because it is used inside its own module. A tree scan AND a runtime coverage walk must both find every export consumed outside its defining module.
One mechanism for one idea must carry one persisted name; no concept may be implemented twice under different names. A static schema-catalog audit must find no two mechanisms for the same duty.

No module may grow past the point where its responsibilities can be read as one unit. The largest modules must be restructured or the criterion stays failed; a static size audit AND a runtime load-trace review must both confirm the unit stays within its readable bound.

Values crossing the database boundary must be converted exactly once at the data-access boundary. Re-coercion with Number() at call sites must be absent; a static coercion scan AND a runtime type-trail check must both show the conversion happens at one point.
